title: A 1,200-Pound Moose Dives Underwater to Eat Its Lunch

scenes.text: This giant of the forest goes diving for lunch.
A bull moose can weigh twelve hundred pounds, and swim about six miles an hour.
It dives to graze on pondweed on the bottom, more than a dozen feet down.
Valves in its nostrils close underwater, and tighten as the pressure rises.
Those water plants supply much of a moose's sodium and other minerals.
A healthy moose eats forty to sixty pounds of food a day. Some of it comes from underwater.

description:
This giant of the forest goes diving for lunch.
A bull moose swims about six miles an hour and dives for pondweed, closing its nostril valves underwater.
